existingFixParts.note: THE fix part for the 'Pentastar tick'. Latest 'AH' revision adds a dual snap-ring roller retainer + thicker fulcrum steel so the roller stays captured even if needle bearings degrade — always install the newest revision to avoid a repeat (earlier AF clip-snap could drop the rocker into the head). En

existingFixParts.note: Sits between cam lobe and rocker; when a rocker/needle-bearing fails, metal debris circulates and can damage the lash adjusters, so they are inspected and replaced with the rockers (commonly sold together in 24-pc rocker+lifter kits). Fits 3.6L Pentastar 2011-2023 incl. Ram 1500. Verified on Mopar e
existingFixParts.component: Hydraulic valve lash adjuster / lifter (inspect-replace, debris circulates)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part. Fel-Pro HS26157PT multi-layer-steel (MLS) full head gasket set is the canonical part for the 4.7L PowerTech/Magnum SOHC V8. Verified live fitment: Ram 1500 4.7L 2002-2007 (SOHC 4.7 castings run through 2009). Set includes 2 MLS head gaskets, exhaust/valve-cover gaskets and seals
existingFixParts.component: Cylinder head gasket set (MLS, full upper set)

existingFixParts.note: Head bolts on the 4.7L are torque-to-yield and MUST be replaced, not reused, when the heads come off. Fel-Pro ES71129 is the verified set (28 bolts: 20 long / 8 short) for 4.7L Dodge/Ram 2000-2012, reduced-diameter heads allow re-torque without valvetrain removal. Confirmed live at AutoZone and JEGS
existingFixParts.component: Cylinder head bolt set (torque-to-yield, one-time use)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part. Integrated air dryer is built into the compressor assembly (no separate dryer PN) — replacing the compressor renews the dryer, which is the moisture-purge component the FIX calls out. 68597424AA is the current Mopar service assembly for 2013-2018 Ram 1500 DS; earlier/interchange
existingFixParts.component: Air suspension compressor assembly with integrated dryer (4th-gen 2013-2018/19 DS)

existingFixParts.note: Front corners of the 4-corner system use air struts, not coil struts. 4877146AA = front LEFT, 4877147AA = front RIGHT (sold individually; replace in pairs). Fits 2013-2019 Ram 1500 / 2019-2020 Classic with 3.0L EcoDiesel, 3.6L V6, 5.7L V8. These are the leaking front bags the leak-down/soap test tar
existingFixParts.component: Front air suspension strut (air spring shock) - Left & Right (2013-2019 DS)

existingFixParts.note: Rear corners of the 4-corner system. 68248948AA supersedes 4877136AA/AB. Fits 2013-2020 Ram 1500 and 2019-2020 Classic. One per side; replace leaking bag(s) found during the soap/leak-down test.
existingFixParts.component: Rear air spring bag (2013-2020 DS)

existingFixParts.note: Height sensors throw the ride-height faults / 'Service Air Suspension' message. 56029595AC = LEFT FRONT (2013-2014); rear-left is 56029617AA/AB. results.component: governor pressure solenoid
results.repairRoleEvidence: replace the governor pressure solenoid (Mopar 4617210) and the governor pressure sensor/transducer (56028196AD, supersession of 56041403AA)

existingFixParts.note: Cited in FIX. Verified real Mopar OE PN 4617210 (also carried as 52118652). Fits 1994-on A500/42RE, 44RE, A518/46RE, A618/47RE and 48RE — covers the entire 1994-2001 window for this issue. This is the PWM solenoid the PCM pulses to control governor pressure; a common limp-mode cause. Sold standalone
existingFixParts.component: Governor pressure solenoid (PWM transmission governor solenoid)

existingFixParts.note: Cited in FIX. Verified real Mopar OE PN, 4-pin RECTANGULAR connector, fits 2000-up (2000-2001 within this issue's window). NOTE: this is NOT a blanket supersession of 56041403AA — the pre-2000 sensor uses a different (oval) connector, so for 1996-1999 Rams use 56041403AA instead (listed separately).
existingFixParts.component: Governor pressure sensor / transducer (2000-2001 rectangular-connector version)

existingFixParts.note: Era-correct sensor for 1996-1999 42RE/46RE Rams (4-pin OVAL connector). Verified real Mopar OE PN. Provided so the 1996-1999 portion of this 1994-2001 issue gets the right-era part — do NOT substitute the 2000+ 56028196AD (rectangular connector) on these earlier trucks. Kits often list both PNs inte
existingFixParts.component: Governor pressure sensor / transducer (1996-1999 oval-connector version)

existingFixParts.note: FIX calls for a new filter with the fluid change. 52118789 is the verified Mopar filter for the A518/46RE (5.9L Rams). NOTE: 42RE (3.9L V6 / 5.2L) Rams use a different, shallower filter (e.g. 52118307) — match to the actual transmission. Filter is a required consumable for the pan-drop repair.
existingFixParts.component: Transmission valve-body filter (with fresh ATF+4 service)

existingFixParts.note: Required to reseal the pan after dropping it to reach the valve-body solenoid/sensor. Verified Mopar pan-gasket PN for A500/42RE/A518/46RE. Some services reuse the OE reusable rubber gasket; replacement recommended. Modifier/consumable for the documented fix.
existingFixParts.component: Transmission oil pan gasket

existingFixParts.note: Small gasket that seals the governor pressure solenoid pack to the valve body — needed when the solenoid is replaced. Verified Mopar PN; frequently bundled into the aftermarket solenoid+sensor kits, so may not need separate purchase.
existingFixParts.component: Governor solenoid-to-valve-body gasket
aftermarketXref: included in most Hercoo/Sonnax governor kits

existingFixParts.note: FIX specifies fresh ATF+4. 68218057AB is the current licensed Mopar ATF+4 quart PN (MS-9602 spec; ATF+4 is fully backward-compatible with the older ATF+3 these trucks shipped with). Price is PER QUART — a pan-drop refill needs ~5-7 qt (~$45-85 total). Any MS-9602-licensed ATF+4 is acceptable.

existingFixParts.note: The cited revised Mopar 'enhanced' pump for the 5.7L HEMI VVT (also covers 6.4L). Era-correct 2011-2026 fitment, covers the 2011-2023 issue range. The enhancement changed the End-of-Line fitting ID (11.1mm->6.5mm) to eliminate cavitation that caused the earlier weep-hole leaks. OEM kit ships complet
existingFixParts.component: Water pump (enhanced/revised) — primary repair part

existingFixParts.note: The alternate water-pump PN named in the fix text. Confirmed real Mopar part, same 2011-2026 / 5.7L HEMI VVT family (with bleeder plug variant); supersession-adjacent to 68346916AB. Use whichever the VIN/casting calls out — either is era-correct for 2011-2023.
existingFixParts.component: Water pump (alternate cited PN)

existingFixParts.note: Correct 195F thermostat for the Ram 1500 5.7L HEMI (NOT 68067109AA, which is the Ram 2500/3500 part — verified and corrected). Includes seal/gasket; redesigned valve reduces oscillation. Routinely replaced alongside the water pump since the cooling system is already open.
existingFixParts.component: Engine coolant thermostat (inspect/replace with pump)

existingFixParts.note: Listed for completeness per the fix text ('replace gasket as needed'). NOTE: the OEM enhanced pump (68346916AB/15AA) already ships WITH its gasket, so this standalone gasket is only required when re-sealing an existing pump or for an aftermarket bare pump that ships without one.
existingFixParts.component: Water pump gasket (standalone — only if reusing a pump)

existingFixParts.note: Correct serpentine belt for the 2013-2024 Ram 1500 5.7L HEMI (non-eTorque). The fix text calls for inspecting/replacing a worn belt because a worn belt/tensioner shortens pump life. OEM ~$67; Gates K060936 cross-ref. Earlier 2011-2012 trucks may use a different length — verify by VIN.
existingFixParts.component: Serpentine accessory drive belt (inspect/replace as needed)

existingFixParts.note: Automatic belt tensioner for the Ram 1500 5.7L HEMI (fits 2009-2024 5.7L). The fix text flags a worn tensioner as a contributing cause; replace if the arm is weak/noisy when the cooling job is open. OEM ~$125; quality aftermarket (Gates/Dayco) ~$35-60.
existingFixParts.component: Drive belt tensioner (inspect/replace as needed)

existingFixParts.note: Required to refill/pressure-test after pump replacement. 68163849AB is the PRE-MIXED 50/50 OAT (purple, Chrysler standard MS-12106, 10yr/150k); 68163848AB is the concentrate (MS-90032). Use the correct purple OAT only — do not mix with HOAT/green. Typically 2-3 gallons for a full HEMI cooling-system
existingFixParts.component: OAT engine coolant/antifreeze (refill after service)
aftermarketXref: Zerex G-05 (do NOT use — wrong spec)

existingFixParts.note: Primary culprit for P0456/P0442 small-leak on 2013-2020 Ram 1500. Mounts to the fuel-vapor charcoal canister near the tank (push-tab/twist lock). 04861959AD supersedes 4861959AA/AB/AC and 52855827AA/AB; fits ~2009-2024 Ram 1500 (also Grand Cherokee/Durango/Charger/300). Verified via Mopar eStore, oe
existingFixParts.component: ESIM — Evaporative System Integrity Monitor (leak-detection module on charcoal canister)

existingFixParts.note: Fails to hold vacuum → P0456/P0442/P0455. Mopar assembly includes the purge valve plus its hose. Fits 2013-2020 Ram 1500 5.7L V8 HEMI MDS VVT. Supersedes 4627996AA/AB. Verified on Mopar eStore, MoparPartsGiant, factorychryslerparts. For 3.6L Pentastar the PN differs — verify by VIN.
existingFixParts.component: EVAP purge (canister purge) control valve — 5.7L HEMI, 2013-2020

existingFixParts.note: Later-generation replacement for the purge valve on 2021-2024 trucks (different PN than the 2013-2020 4627996AC). Listed as Mopar 'Canister Purge Valve 2021-2024 Ram' on the Mopar eStore. Included so the era match is correct for newer trucks in this issue's 2013-2024 span.
existingFixParts.component: EVAP purge (canister purge) valve — 5th-gen 2021-2024 Ram 1500

existingFixParts.note: On 2019+ capless-filler trucks, a worn/debris-fouled internal flapper seal that won't reseal triggers P0456. The seal is NOT sold separately — the complete filler-neck/funnel assembly (68524049AB, supersedes 68524049AA) is the OEM remedy. Clean/inspect the flap first; replace only if it fails to sea
existingFixParts.component: Capless fuel-filler neck / funnel seal assembly — 5th-gen 2019+

existingFixParts.note: The cheapest, first thing to verify on 2013-2020 trucks with a conventional threaded cap — a bad cap seal alone throws P0455/P0456. Mopar 52029561AA listed as 'Fuel Filler Cap 2013-2020 Ram' on Mopar eStore. Not applicable to 2019+ capless trucks.
existingFixParts.component: Fuel filler cap (sealing gas cap) — 2013-2020 non-capless trucks

existingFixParts.note: Solenoid latch assembly for the passenger side — the side specifically flagged in STAR S1808000156 for factory misalignment/no-release. Replace when the solenoid latch is confirmed failed. Confirmed Mopar OEM for 2019-2023+ Ram 1500 DT (also fits through 2026). MSRP ~$85, street ~$56-60.
existingFixParts.component: Tailgate latch assembly, right (passenger side)
aftermarketXref: Conquest Auto Parts DT passenger-side tailgate latch

existingFixParts.note: Solenoid latch assembly for the driver side; the DT tailgate uses a latch on each side, so the failed-side latch (often passenger, but can be either) is replaced. Confirmed Mopar OEM for 2019-2023 Ram 1500 DT. MSRP ~$71, street ~$52.
existingFixParts.component: Tailgate latch assembly, left (driver side)

existingFixParts.note: Striker bolt for striker-to-latch alignment adjustment per the STAR case (and the related 1.2M-unit misaligned-striker recall). Adjusting/retorquing the striker is the primary non-replacement fix; bolt replaced if damaged. Confirmed Mopar OEM for 2019-2025 Ram 1500 DT.
existingFixParts.component: Tailgate striker attachment bolt

existingFixParts.note: Documented lubrication step — DT latches lack factory lubrication and jam from hauled dirt/dust. Mopar Spray White Lube (lithium-based) is the spec'd body/latch lubricant. A consumable, not a year-specific part.
existingFixParts.component: White lithium spray lubricant (latch lubrication)

results.component: front pinion seal
results.repairRoleEvidence: Replace the front pinion seal AND the pinion flange sleeve (wear sleeve) together, not the seal alone, since a grooved sleeve will re-leak

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part. Mopar 5086697AB = AAM 40017140, the front differential pinion (input) seal for the AAM 9.25" front axle in 2003-2018 Ram 2500/3500 4x4. This seal wears a groove into the flange sleeve, so per the documented fix it must be replaced together with the pinion flange wear sleeve — ne
existingFixParts.component: Front pinion seal (AAM 9.25" front axle)

existingFixParts.note: The grooved wear surface that the pinion seal rides on. AAM steel wear sleeve 26060975 (Torque King QU11106) presses over the pinion flange/yoke sleeve area and restores a smooth sealing surface — this is what stops the repeat-leak the fix describes. Fits 2003-2013 14-bolt and 2013-2018 12-bolt AAM
existingFixParts.component: Pinion flange wear sleeve (repair sleeve)

existingFixParts.note: Convenience bundle that satisfies the 'replace seal AND sleeve together, reset preload' fix in one PN. AAM kit 74020009 contains pinion seal 40017140, wear sleeve 26060975, collapsible crush spacer 14012691, and pinion nut 9783762 — everything needed to correctly reset pinion preload on reassembly.
existingFixParts.component: Complete front pinion seal service kit (seal + sleeve + crush spacer + nut)

existingFixParts.note: For the commonly co-occurring axle-tube (inner shaft) seal seepage the fix says to inspect and replace at the same time. AAM axle seal kit 74050016 includes two housing/tube seals 40011965 plus the eight retaining bolts with adhesive (40011986) — one kit does both sides. Fits 2003-2012+ Ram 2500/350
